title: Certified lower bounds for λ1·Area on cells of pentagon shape space by piecewise-affine transplantation, an explicit ball of strict minimality of the regular pentagon, and the Pólya–Szegő inequality for convex pentagons
description:
Computer-assisted proof candidates (for the stated cells, the stated ball and, in version 2.0, all convex pentagons), not peer reviewed. Non-convex pentagons are not covered.

Version 2.0 adds convex_theorem/: a computer-assisted proof candidate that λ1·Area of every convex pentagon is at least that of the regular pentagon, with equality only for pentagons similar to the regular one, in three parts (the explicit ball of version 1.1, an annulus covered by Lehmann–Goerisch box certificates, and the remaining convex pentagons in a cut-corner chart); every decision is an exact rational inequality or a statement of ball arithmetic, and all frozen tasks were independently re-certified and replayed by a second-party AI reviewer with separately written programs (not peer review). It was carried out independently of H. Wang's preprint arXiv:2611.22305 (17 November 2026), which claims the inequality for all simple polygons with at most n ≥ 5 sides; we learned of it on 23 November 2026, after the certificates had been computed, and make no priority claim.

Version 1.1 adds local_theorem/: a computer-assisted proof candidate that the regular pentagon is the strict minimiser of F in the explicit ball |z − c|₂ < 52429/2²⁰ of the fixed-first-edge shape chart, with a certificate checked in exact rational arithmetic, independent of the PAQC certificates; both levels of its certificate were recomputed by a second-party AI reviewer with separately written programs (not peer review). The new local theorem makes no claim outside that ball. Version 1.0 (1 November 2026) remains available unchanged. A preprint by H. Wang (arXiv:2611.22305, 17 November 2026) claims a proof of the Pólya–Szegő inequality for all simple polygons with at most n ≥ 5 sides; it has not been peer reviewed, and neither version of this repository depends on it.

Version 1.0 content:

A method (PAQC) that certifies F(P) = λ1(P)·|P| > F(regular pentagon) simultaneously for every pentagon P in a six-dimensional box of shape space, using only the first Dirichlet eigenvalues of the 64 corner pentagons and exact matrix inequalities from a piecewise-affine transplantation; six certificates for five boxes, evaluated in ball arithmetic; a partial independent second-party replay; a short paper; and an estimate of the cost of covering a whole region. AI assistance is disclosed in README.md. Licences: text and data CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
